text:
talia (PM): quick sync — we need to lock scope for the 'inference economics signals' initiative so eng can plan q2 work. customer asks are piling up: devs want per-route batching advice, infra asks for cache TTL hints, and support wants eval-driven alerts when model changes regress cost/quality. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sanjay (Eng): high level: we can split into three orthogonal deliverables: 1) Offline advisor (batch/cache/quant recs) 2) Runtime hints (live batching + KV cache guidance) 3) Eval alerts (hook into existing eval pipeline). each has different infra deps.

lee (ML): +1. For quant suggestions we need model family coverage first (Llama2/Redwood-v2/Meta-Open). We should only recommend quant profiles that have been validated on our eval sets.

maria (Design): for Console, minimal UI needs: a single 'Advisor' panel showing recommendations, expected token-savings (%), estimated latency impact, and a confidence score. screenshots later but we need fields defined now.

devin (SRE): dependency: runtime telemetry for per-request token counts, model variant tags, and cache hit metrics. without that we can't compute per-route ROI. ETA to add telemetry: ~2 sprints if prioritized.

lee (ML): initial heuristics for recommendations: batching -> suggest max_batch_size when p95 latency < target and throughput drop > X; caching -> suggest prefix lengths and TTL when prefix-repeat rate > 0.2; quant -> recommend if eval regressed accuracy < threshold (0.5%) and cost benefit > 15%.

talia (PM): concrete ask: can we define an MVP that is useful to customers but small enough to ship? propose MVP = { offline CSV advisor + Console view + alerting for eval regressions } where offline advisor runs weekly and produces actionable rows per-route.

sanjay (Eng): feasible MVP but need to scope offline advisor outputs: for each route produce: recommended batch_size, suggested cache_ttl(s), suggested quant_profile, expected token savings, confidence. implementation: map-reduce job over past 14d of traces. effort: 3 engs x 6 wks (including metrics infra).

devin (SRE): +1 on map-reduce approach. Add canary: only surface recs to internal customers first (beta). We'll also need a feature flag gated in Console.

maria (Design): UI MVP: table with columns [route, model, rec_batch, rec_cache_ttl, rec_quant, est_savings, confidence, last_eval_score]. allow CSV export. Low-fidelity ready by EOW. :+1:

lee (ML): Eval-triggered alerts: hook into eval job results. If quality delta > 1.0% absolute or cost delta < -15% (i.e., much cheaper but degraded), send alert and show diff on the route row.

talia (PM): launch criteria suggestion (must-haves): 1) Advisor produces recs for >= 50% of traffic routes (by qps) 2) Console shows recs and export 3) Eval-alert rules in defaults and customers can opt into alerts 4) Beta customers (3) sign up and confirm at least one actionable rec accepted.

sanjay (Eng): risk: recommending batching/quant without runtime fallbacks could introduce regressions. Mitigation: recommendations must include 'safe-mode' flags and rollouts only via 'apply' endpoint that triggers canary verification run on a small % of traffic.

devin (SRE): telemetry gap list: per-request token counts, route->model mapping, runtime quant flags, cache-hit logs. I'll make a ticket and prioritize with infra squad.

maria (Design): question: do we surface confidence level as numeric or buckets? customers asked for simple guidance.

lee (ML): buckets (High/Med/Low) plus raw expected savings number. Also link to sample eval prompts that drove the decision.

talia (PM): prioritization: 1) offline advisor (highest customer ROI, low runtime risk) 2) telemetry work (blocks runtime features) 3) eval-alerts integration 4) runtime auto-apply flows (longer tail). Does everyone agree?

sanjay (Eng): agree. Proposed timeline: discovery + infra spikes (2 sprints), build offline advisor (6 wks), console + alerts (4 wks), beta (3 wks). adjust after infra spike.

devin (SRE): assign tickets after spike, will confirm telemetry ETA.

maria (Design): I'll drop low-fi mockups to the thread by tomorrow and collect feedback.

talia (PM): action items: @sanjay create epic + initial tasks; @devin list telemetry gaps as tickets; @lee outline eval thresholds and datasets; @maria mockups. We'll meet next Tue to finalize acceptance criteria. Thanks :sparkles:

reliability-bot: scheduled meeting created for Tue 10:00 AM — "Econ signals roadmap sync" (invite: @talia @sanjay @lee @devin @maria).

sanjay (Eng): FYI: rough estimate for engineering: 650-900 engineer-hours for MVP depending on telemetry reuse. Need to decide budget by EOD Friday.

talia (PM): noted. I'll pull customer ask priority and budget guidance from GTM before EOD.

lee (ML): one more thing — we should include a simple CLI that lets SEs run advisor on a local trace sample. That reduces support friction.

devin (SRE): good idea. We'll add a flag in the beta to enable local-run artifacts.

maria (Design): added a tiny note: keep recommended language prescriptive but reversible. e.g., 'Recommend apply batch_size=16 (expected -18% token cost). [Apply] [Preview]'.

talia (PM): perfect. closing notes: we've got clear MVP, acceptance criteria to flesh out next Tue, and owners assigned. thanks everyone. :clap:
